text:
Jo: Rue found the one sunbeam and also dug into the monstera pot. refuses to move. pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F67890/rue_monstera.jpg :joy_cat: 
Maya: AAAAA she is the plant guardian now. :heart_eyes: 
Sam: that is a very specific throne. who appointed Rue monarch of the monstera? :crown: 
Jo: I tried bribing with treats. Rue accepts only ceremonial pets and the occasional kibble. 
Elliot: Honestly, brilliant turf strategy. If we want to repot we must file form `PLANT-TRANSFER-REQ` :face_with_monocle: 
Maya: poll: who volunteers to water/rotate the monstera so Rue doesn't get territorial? options: me / sam / jo / split rota (Mon/Wed/Fri) 
Sam: I'll take watering this week if Maya does rotation duties next week. :raised_hands: 
GardenBot: Reminder set — Water Monstera for Sam on 2024-07-08 09:00 AM. (scheduled via /gardens) :seedling: 
Jo: Agreement recorded. Also added training: `how to politely ask a dog to vacate a pot` (step 1: treats, step 2: spin, step 3: carry out of pot). 
Maya: Vote's in: me + Elliot = rota, Sam = water this week. Rue approves (stared at me until I conceded). :thumbsup: 
Elliot: can we get another pic for the weekly `pets-and-plants` roundup? Rue in a hat would seal the deal. :camera_with_flash: 
Jo: OK one more — uploading Rue wearing a tiny bandana in 5m. brace for maximum smug. :smirk:
